title: Malicious code in ep_nxs31521 (npm)
description: The npm package ep_nxs31521 version 1.0.0 contains malicious code that registers an undocumented, unauthenticated HTTP GET route on Etherpad servers. This route discloses sensitive server information such as hostname, username, platform, Node.js version, current working directory, and process ID. The exposed data can be accessed by any remote caller without authentication, indicating a reconnaissance risk. The route branding suggests unauthorized defacement rather than legitimate functionality.
